publication_selection_notes: 2025 CRF250R overlaps Helm 61K9550 and 61K9561. Both catalog claims are recorded; neither establishes supersession or complete VIN-specific coverage. Confirm intended edition with Helm/Honda before ordering.
Helm also lists 61K9560 for 2025–2026 CRF250R, temporarily unavailable; 61K9561 is the separately verified 2025–2027 listing.
Kawasaki 99830-0039-09 MSRP $95.75 is explicitly indexed on the 2022 KX250 page (and 2024 KX250X listing); no independently observed price assigned to 2023/2024 standard-model rows.
Kawasaki service manuals are separate purchase products. Owner-manual VIEW MANUAL links are not evidence of a publicly readable service manual.
remaining_gaps: Kawasaki KX450 2022,2023,2024,2026 exact official purchase SKU/year mapping remains unresolved in this pass. Do not transfer the 2025 SKU across those years.
Paid factory service manual bodies remain unacquired. Six public competition handbooks provide selected torque facts and section references, not full diagnostic coverage.
2025–2026 Honda competition handbook acquisition is handled in the root pass; do not infer those years from 2022–2024 records.
